name: 08221 · Linwood, NJ
findings: ZIP 08221 (Linwood) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08221 (Linwood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08221 (Linwood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
